chunks: Have the plotters of mischief become unafraid that God will not split the earth to swallow them, or that punishment will not fall upon them from somewhere they do not (even) suspect?

key_terms.يَخْسِفَ: To split or swallow up (the earth)

ai.seo_question: How does God punish those who plot evil according to Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the suddenness of divine retribution, often linked to the concept of *ghaflah* (heedlessness) where the wicked are caught unaware by Allah's power. The imagery of the earth swallowing them recalls the fate of Pharaoh's people, while the unexpected punishment highlights God's omnipresence beyond human perception. This serves as a spiritual warning to maintain constant vigilance (*muraqabah*) in one's deeds.
